claims.text: Rosewood Phuket sits along a 600-meter beachfront on Emerald Bay.

findings.quote: Nestled along a 600-meter beachfront on Emerald Bay, Rosewood Phuket is a 5-star resort

claims.text: Accommodation is a collection of pavilions, houses and villas beside the white sands of Emerald Bay.

findings.quote: A contemporary collection of pavilions, houses, and luxury villas in Phuket beside the white sands of Emerald Bay

claims.text: Lagoon Pool Pavilions have Andaman Sea views and a private plunge pool.

findings.quote: Lagoon Pool Pavilions showcase Andaman Sea views matched by stylish design and private plunge pool.

claims.text: Partial Ocean View Pool Pavilions have floor-to-ceiling windows, a plunge pool and an outdoor bathtub.

findings.quote: Partial Ocean View Pool Pavilions feature a tropical setting, floor-to-ceiling windows, plunge pool and an outdoor bath tub.

claims.text: Ta Khai serves traditional Southern Thai cuisine made with local ingredients and a zero-waste commitment.

findings.quote: Traditional Southern Thai cuisine, lovingly crafted with local ingredients and a zero-waste commitment.

claims.text: Red Sauce is an Italian restaurant with views over Emerald Bay.

findings.quote: Red Sauce is an authentic Italian restaurant in Phuket with idyllic views over Emerald Bay.

claims.text: Mai is a poolside lounge for daytime pool time and evening cocktails, with views of Emerald Bay.

findings.quote: Sophisticated poolside lounge
Daytime pool vibes, evening cocktails. Mai offers a chic escape with cool music and stunning views of Emerald Bay.

claims.text: The Shack serves simply prepared seafood poolside.

findings.quote: Experience island life at The Shack, with simply prepared seafood for a rustic dining experience poolside.

claims.text: Complimentary water sports equipment includes kayaks and SUPs.

findings.quote: our complimentary water sports equipments including kayaks, SUPs and more

claims.text: The resort has dedicated padel courts.

findings.quote: enjoy fast-paced fun and socializing with friends and family on our dedicated padel courts

claims.text: Excursions include ethical elephant encounters, Old Town, yacht trips to Phang Nga Bay and helicopter flights.

findings.quote: Curated adventures unfold: ethical elephant encounters, Old Town's allure, yacht voyages to Phang Nga Bay's karsts and pristine isles, plus breathtaking helicopter perspectives.

claims.text: The resort offers sound therapy with Tibetan singing bowls.

findings.quote: Tibetan singing bowls are placed on and around your body as your energy fields are balanced and enhanced through the resonating sound and vibrations.

claims.text: The Ocean House has Emerald Bay views, a private pool, garden terraces and courtyards.

findings.quote: The Ocean House, with stunning Emerald Bay views, offers a private pool, garden terraces and courtyards.

claims.text: Ta Khai uses produce from its own organic herb and vegetable garden.

findings.quote: Ta Khai menu features produce from 100% locally sourced ingredients, including those from its own organic herb and vegetable garden.

claims.text: Guests can take a guided tour of the organic Little Bukit Farm followed by a zero-mile tasting dinner.

findings.quote: Little Bukit Farm
A guided tour of this organic island farm with owner Melinda and our Executive Chef Luca De Negri prior to an epicurean zero-mile tasting dinner.

claims.text: The resort has a free-form infinity pool that merges with the waters of the bay.

findings.quote: The free-form infinity pool is a tranquil oasis merging seamlessly with the shimmering waters of the bay.

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the Andaman Sea is visible from everywhere in the resort.

findings.quote: And the Andaman Sea is visible from everywhere.

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the bungalows are spread up and down the hillside, with pools, spa, bars and restaurants scattered throughout.

findings.quote: free standing bungalows go up and down the hillside, while pools, the spa, and bars and restaurants are scattered throughout

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the secluded location requires transportation for exploring.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the ultra-luxury positioning.
